definitions.explanation: A notebook or book specifically intended for writing a daily diary. Refers to the physical object rather than the content.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{日記帳|にっきちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
⟦{毎晩|まいばん}→毎晩：00967_maiban⟧{日記帳|にっきちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書|か}いている→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: I write in my diary every night.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{遺品|いひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{日記帳|にっきちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: An old diary was found among my grandmother's belongings.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{日記|にっき}→日記：01486_nikki⟧ (diary) + ⟦{帳|ちょう}→帳：10012_chou⟧ (notebook). While ⟦{日記|にっき}→日記：01486_nikki⟧ can refer to both the practice of keeping a diary and the book itself, {日記帳|にっきちょう} specifically emphasizes the physical book or notebook.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日記帳|にっきちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to buy a diary
- {日記帳|にっきちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write in a diary
- {日記帳|にっきちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to keep a diary
- {五年|ごねん}{日記帳|にっきちょう}: five-year diary

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{日記|にっき}→日記：01486_nikki⟧: diary — refers to both the practice and the record; {日記帳|にっきちょう} is specifically the book
- ダイアリー: diary — loanword, often used for planner-style diaries
- ⟦{手帳|てちょう}→手帳：04537_techou⟧: planner, pocket notebook — a personal organizer, not specifically for diary entries
